usdRate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, official exchange rate (PA.NUS.FCRF), Togo, 2025 average
usdRate.note: 581.9 CFA francs per dollar on average in 2025; the BCEAO reference rate was 584.84 on 2 November 2026 (just after the research date). The franc is fixed at 655.957 per euro.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, citing the national statistics office (INSEED/DGSCN) consumer price index, September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Secondary source: consumer prices up 2.4% year on year in September 2026 after 0.7% in August; the BCEAO economic note of September 2026 confirms 0.7% for August (1.6% in July). Fuel prices were raised in May and September 2026.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BCEAO inflation target (1-3% band, centre 2%); World Bank CPI inflation 2025 (0.4%)
inflation_projection.note: The CFA franc is pegged to the euro and the BCEAO aims at 1-3%; Togo's inflation has mostly stayed in or below that band, so its 2% centre is used for long-range plans.

policy_rate.sourceName: BCEAO economic note for UEMOA countries, September 2026: Monetary Policy Committee of 9 September 2026
policy_rate.note: Main policy rate (minimum bid rate for liquidity tenders) kept at 3.00%; marginal lending facility 5.00%. Common to all eight UMOA countries.

savings_account_rate.note: No average rate on ordinary savings accounts in Togo was found; the BCEAO bank-conditions survey (first half 2026) lists term-deposit and contractual-savings rates only.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Togo)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Median of the minimum term-deposit rates (taux DAT minimum) that Togo's 16 banks and the postal bank declare to the BCEAO (range 2.5-4.25%); the minimum usually applies to small, short deposits. Not a tenor-specific average.

fdr_1y_rate.note: The BCEAO bank-conditions survey gives only minimum (median 3.5%) and maximum (median about 6.45%, range 4.2-7.0%) term-deposit rates per bank in Togo for the first half of 2026, not a 1-year rate.

dps_rate.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Togo)
dps_rate.note: Contractual savings plans (épargne contractuelle): most Togo banks declare a range starting at 3.5% (ranges between 2.0% and 5.0%); the median lower bound is used.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: BCEAO economic note for UEMOA countries, September 2026 (bank deposit rates, July 2026)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average deposit rate across all UMOA banks (the eight-country union, not Togo alone), 5.15% in July 2026 (5.12% in June); the note says only that Togo's rate fell 1 basis point in the month. Togo banks' declared term-deposit rates run from a median minimum of 3.5% to a median maximum of about 6.45% (BCEAO bank-conditions survey, first half 2026). World Bank FR.INR.DPST for Togo dates from 2016.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate sold to individuals was found; the Treasury borrows through UMOA-Titres auctions of bills and bonds, open to individuals only through banks and licensed brokers.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Togo yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month zero-coupon rate 5.86% (5.97% after smoothing); 1-year 5.17%. The results of Togo's October 2026 auctions were not published on the UMOA-Titres pages.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Togo yield curve (zero coupon) at 23 October 2026

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: UMOA-Titres, Togo yield curve (rate after smoothing) at 23 October 2026
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year smoothed rate 6.30%; the raw zero-coupon point is 5.48%, out of line with the 7-8 year points (6.9-7.6%), so the smoothed curve is used.

tax_bank_interest.note: The tax on interest from bank deposits for individuals could not be confirmed: PwC Tax Summaries has no Togo page and the 2026 fiscal handbook of the Office Togolais des Recettes is a scanned image without the rate.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of interest on Togo Treasury securities for individuals could not be confirmed from an official source.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: UMOA Council of Ministers, Decision No. 009 of 30 June 2017 (FGD-UMOA contribution rates and compensation limits), article 2
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Deposits are guaranteed up to 1,400,000 FCFA per depositor per bank (300,000 FCFA at a microfinance institution) by the regional deposit guarantee fund; the decision dates from 2017 (older than 2025) and is still the one the fund publishes.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions débitrices of UMOA credit institutions, first half 2026 (Togo)
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Median of the maximum lending rates (taux débiteur maximum) declared by the 16 credit institutions in Togo for the first half of 2026 (13.5% and 14% either side of the middle; range 9-18%); it applies to all bank credit, including cards. No card-specific rate or legal usury rate was read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO economic note, September 2026 (regional stock exchange BRVM, deposit rates)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: regional (BRVM) equities return about the bank deposit rate, as in their weak 2016-2020 years.

equity_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO economic note, September 2026; UMOA-Titres Togo yield curve
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.5 points above after-tax term deposits and one-year government bills (about 4.5-5%), within the 4-point cap, because the BRVM's 10-year record is uneven despite a 60.7% rise in the composite index in the year to August 2026.

equity_return_high.sourceName: BCEAO economic note, September 2026 (BRVM indices and capitalisation)
equity_return_high.note: High case: the BRVM repeats a strong decade like 2023-2026.

gold_return_low.sourceName: BCEAO reference exchange rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat gold in euro terms.

gold_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO reference exchange rates (CFA franc pegged at 655.957 per euro)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: the long-run dollar gold trend of about 4% a year plus a small allowance for the euro-pegged franc weakening against the dollar.

gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years such as 2024-2025.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at the 3.5% floor rate, less a possible tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO bank conditions (Togo term deposits 3.5-6.45%); UMOA-Titres Togo yield curve (1 year 5.2%)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: larger term deposits (median maximum about 6.45%) or 1-year Treasury bills (5.2%) through a bank, less tax on interest, rounded down because the tax rate is unconfirmed.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 3-5 year Treasury bonds or regional public bond issues at 6-7%.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: CIMA (the regional insurance regulator) and Togo's insurance directorate publish no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Temporary death cover is sold under the CIMA code, but no published premium rates per 1,000 FCFA of cover by age were found from a public source.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay in Togo was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premiums by age were found from a public source.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Togo
oop_health_share.note: 64.3% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database), the latest available and older than 2025; universal health insurance (AMU) has been extended since 2024.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BCEAO economic note, September 2026; inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_health.note: No national medical CPI series was read; private medical costs usually rise faster than general prices, so 1.5 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BCEAO economic note, September 2026; inflation assumption 2%
goal_inflation_education.note: No national education CPI series was read; private school fees usually rise faster than general prices, so 2 points above the 2% inflation assumption.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Togo
life_expectancy.note: 62.9 years in 2024 (men 62.7, women 63.2), the latest World Bank year (older than 2025); UN WPP 2024 gives 63.3 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for 2026; totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 6.20 (2025, World Bank), 7.1 (2040) and 10.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/togo/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Togo social security system: CNSS old-age insurance
retirement_age_default.note: CNSS old-age pension at 60 with 180 months of insurance (55 for premature wear); voluntary early pension from 55, reduced 5% a year. The page is dated 2026 without a precise day.

retirement_age_government.note: The civil-service retirement age could not be confirmed from an official source; the civil servants' pension fund (Caisse de Retraites du Togo) site does not state it.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: small term deposits or contractual savings at about 3.5%, less a possible tax on interest.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BCEAO, conditions créditrices, first half 2026 (Togo); UMOA-Titres Togo 1-year rate 5.2%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: term deposits at 3.5-6.45% less tax on interest; below the after-tax one-year deposit and Treasury bill rates.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: part of the money in short Treasury bonds bought through a bank.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: a mix earning about after-tax deposit rates.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Togo yield curve; equity base 8%; gold base 4.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of deposits or Treasury bonds, regional equity funds and some gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: UMOA-Titres Togo yield curve; equity high 12%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory old-age pension for Togo was found; the CLEISS summary of Togo social security describes contributory CNSS benefits only, but no source confirming that none exists was read.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found (see old_age_allowance_monthly).

gratuity_rule.note: No official text on a statutory end-of-service or retirement indemnity for private employees in Togo could be read (the Labour Code and the inter-professional collective agreement were not reached).

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CLEISS (French social security liaison body), the Togo social security system: CNSS old-age insurance
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory CNSS pension for private employees: 20% of the average uncapped wage of the last 5 years after 180 months of insurance, plus 1.33% per extra 12 months; at least 60% of the minimum wage (52,500 FCFA) and at most 80% of the average wage; a lump sum of one month's wage per year of insurance for 12-179 months. Revaluation and tax treatment not stated. Civil servants belong to the Caisse de Retraites du Togo.

fdr_3m.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

fdr_1y.note: Banks declare minimum and maximum term-deposit rates to the BCEAO twice a year.

dps.note: Monthly savings plans offered by most Togo banks at about 3.5-5%.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers (SGI).

tbond_5y.note: Auctioned through UMOA-Titres; individuals buy through banks or licensed brokers (SGI).

tbond_10y.note: Togo's yield curve runs to 15 years; long bonds are issued less often.

equity_fund.note: Supervised by the regional financial market authority (AMF-UMOA); equity funds invest on the regional exchange (BRVM).

gold.note: Gold is mainly bought as jewellery; bars and coins are uncommon.

centralBank.name: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)

insuranceRegulator.name: Commission Régionale de Contrôle des Assurances (CIMA)
insuranceRegulator.note: Regional insurance regulator for the CIMA member states; Togo's insurance directorate is in the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

pensionScheme.name: Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS), old-age pension
pensionScheme.note: Civil servants' pensions are paid by the Caisse de Retraites du Togo (https://www.crt.tg/).

publicHealthCover.name: Assurance Maladie Universelle (AMU), Institut National d'Assurance Maladie (INAM)

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de Garantie des Dépôts et de Résolution dans l'UMOA (FGDR-UMOA)

statistics.name: Institut National de la Statistique et des Études Économiques et Démographiques (INSEED)
